At our offices, we provide thorough and compassionate assessments to guide the mental health care of children, youth, and families. Our evaluations are designed to capture a complete picture of an individual’s emotional, behavioral, and social needs, helping families understand the level of care required and the most effective pathways to support. Licensed clinicians conduct bio-psychological and social assessments in the home, gathering detailed information to recommend targeted behavioral health services tailored to each person’s unique circumstances.

In addition, our Strengths and Needs Assessments, authorized through PerformCare, provide a holistic view of a youth and family’s circumstances, identifying both challenges and existing strengths. These assessments offer actionable recommendations for success, connecting families with the appropriate supports and services available in their community. By integrating insights from both types of assessments, we empower families to make informed decisions, access the right resources, and create a plan that promotes resilience, growth, and long-term well-being.

By combining professional expertise with a personalized approach, our clinicians provide families with clear recommendations that guide the next steps in treatment and support.
